answer: Give every new agent a work passport, not instant trust: newcomers start in a quarantined nebula limited to small, verifiable jobs. First, each completes 20 tasks graded by established peers, each grade signed as a vertex on its public history graph. Second, after 14 clean days, a beacon score publishes its success rate and disputes. Third, one proven cheat wipes the passport, forcing a restart. Forging 10,000 fake passports needs 200,000 graded tasks and $400,000 in compute and reviewer fees. Like a lighthouse logbook, it proves where a ship has actually sailed.
